asks.26-readme-usage: Add a "## Usage" section to README.md that shows how to call `greet` from src/hello.py.
asks.10-celsius: Implement `c_to_f(c)` in src/units.py, converting Celsius to Fahrenheit.
asks.04-palindrome: Implement `is_palindrome(s)` in src/text.py, ignoring case, spaces and punctuation.
asks.08-count-vowels: Implement `count_vowels(s)` in src/text.py: the number of vowels (a, e, i, o, u), case-insensitive.
asks.23-rle-decode: Implement `unrle(s)` in src/codec.py: "a3b1c12" becomes "aaab" followed by twelve "c".
asks.19-merge-sorted: Implement `merge(a, b)` in src/lists.py: merge two sorted lists into one sorted list without calling sort.
asks.05-parse-pairs: Implement `parse_pairs(s)` in src/config.py: "k=v;k2=v2" becomes {"k": "v", "k2": "v2"}; empty parts are skipped and spaces around keys and values are trimmed.
asks.17-binary-search: Implement `index_of(xs, x)` in src/search.py with binary search on a sorted list: the index of x, or -1.
asks.06-average-empty: Fix `average(xs)` in src/stats.py so that an empty list returns 0.0 instead of failing.
asks.25-gcd-lcm: Implement `gcd(a, b)` and `lcm(a, b)` in src/arith.py without importing math.
asks.03-reverse-words: Implement `reverse_words(s)` in src/text.py: the words of s in reverse order, joined by single spaces.
asks.09-rename-function: Rename the function `calc_total` in src/cart.py to `total`, and update its caller in src/report.py.
asks.12-stack: Implement a `Stack` class in src/stack.py with push(x), pop() (raising IndexError when empty), peek(), and len().
asks.07-flatten: Implement `flatten(xs)` in src/lists.py: a nested list of any depth becomes a flat list, in order.
asks.11-max-of-bug: Fix `max_of(xs)` in src/stats.py: it returns the wrong answer when every number is negative.
asks.18-initials-bug: Fix `initials(name)` in src/names.py: "ada lovelace" must give "A.L.".
asks.15-roman-to-int: Implement `roman_to_int(s)` in src/roman.py for numerals up to 3999.
asks.20-chunks: Implement `chunks(xs, n)` in src/lists.py: split xs into lists of n items, the last one shorter if needed.
asks.01-fizzbuzz: Implement `fizzbuzz(n)` in src/kata.py: return "Fizz" for multiples of 3, "Buzz" for multiples of 5, "FizzBuzz" for both, else the number as a string.
asks.24-transpose: Implement `transpose(m)` in src/matrix.py for a rectangular list of lists.
asks.13-dedupe: Implement `dedupe(xs)` in src/lists.py: remove duplicates, keeping the first occurrence of each, in order.
asks.21-email: Implement `is_email(s)` in src/validate.py: true for a simple address like "a.b@example.org", false without an "@" or a dotted domain.
asks.02-range-sum-off-by-one: Fix the bug in `range_sum(a, b)` in src/sums.py: it must return the sum of the integers from a to b, both included.
asks.14-top-words: Implement `top_words(text, n)` in src/text.py: the n most frequent lower-cased words as (word, count) pairs, most frequent first, ties broken alphabetically.
